name: shell-online
description: Turn any terminal process into a collaborative browser link.

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:web && npm run build:cli && npm run verify:downloads
scripts.test: vitest run && sh ./scripts/test-install.sh && sh ./scripts/test-docker-entrypoint.sh && sh ./scripts/test-deploy-production.sh && sh ./scripts/test-qemu-linux.sh --check && node ./scripts/test-landing-seo.mjs && node ./scripts/test-mobile-controls.mjs && node ./scripts/check-formula.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.standalone.json --noEmit
scripts.test:app: npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix app test
